title: Xiaomi Smart Camera 4 Max AI Zoom Edition Now Available for Sale: Integrated with an AI Large Model, Priced at 799 Yuan
excerpt: Xiaomi Smart Camera 4Max AI Zoom Edition was officially released on August 7th after four months of crowdfunding preheating, with a price of 799 yuan and 739 yu
content_html:
Xiaomi Smart Camera 4Max AI Zoom Edition was officially released on August 7th after four months of crowdfunding preheating, with a price of 799 yuan and 739 yuan on JD.com. The most core change of this machine is not the camera itself, but its built-in first Xiaomi AI care model, which runs on a 3T flagship 4-core chip, with three times the computing power of the previous generation.

Previously, traditional cameras only did one thing — tell you "someone moved" and that's it. This time, with the introduction of the large model, care has been broken down into more granular behavior recognition and semantic understanding. Child care can analyze whether the child is studying, count screen time, and automatically remind when it exceeds the limit; elderly care covers fall detection, reminders for long periods without appearance in certain areas, and warnings for dangerous behaviors; pet care includes identifying eating, toileting, sleeping, and activity status, and even actively reminding if the pet hasn't eaten for a long time. The AI large model also integrates video text search functionality — directly search for natural language like "son studying" or "grandma falling" to jump to the corresponding segment, while automatically generating a daily care report summarizing the activities of family members. Pro person identification accuracy has increased by 20%, and even side faces and back views can be recognized. However, the large model features are not free forever. During the initial sale period, it offers three months of free trial, after which the subscription costs 32.8 yuan per month or 349 yuan per year starting from.

The hardware features a super clear dual-camera setup: a 12MP telephoto lens and an 8MP wide-angle lens, both with f/1.6 large aperture and 6P lenses, supporting 4K quality monitoring and ultra-low light full-color night vision. The telephoto end has a focal length of 8mm and a resolution of 4096x3072, with auto-focus to capture details; the wide-angle end has a focal length of 2.8mm and a 127° ultra-wide angle to cover the entire scene. With the collaboration of the two lenses, it achieves 3x lossless zoom and 12x hybrid zoom, and even adds a photography mode, allowing the camera to capture daily family moments beyond security. The pan-tilt motor speed has increased by 30% compared to C700, supporting full panoramic view of 360° horizontal and 180° vertical, combined with designated person and pet detection tracking, achieving seamless dynamic tracking without blind spots.

content_html_zh:
经过四个月的众筹预热，小米智能相机4Max AI变焦版于8月7日正式发布，京东售价799元、739元。 该机最核心的变化并不是相机本身，而是其内置的首款小米AI关怀模型，运行在3T旗舰4核芯片上，运算能力是上一代的三倍。

以前，传统相机只做一件事——告诉你“有人移动了”，仅此而已。 这次，随着大模型的引入，护理被分解为更细粒度的行为识别和语义理解。 托儿可以分析孩子是否在学习，统计屏幕时间，超过限制时自动提醒；养老护理包括跌倒检测、特定区域长时间未出现提醒、危险行为预警等；宠物护理包括识别进食、如厕、睡眠、活动状态，甚至在宠物长时间没有进食时主动提醒。 AI大模型还集成了视频文本搜索功能，直接搜索“儿子读书”、“奶奶摔倒”等自然语言跳转到相应片段，同时自动生成总结家庭成员活动的日常护理报告。 Pro人物识别准确率提升20%，连侧脸、背影都能识别。 然而，大型模型功能并不是永远免费的。 首发期间，提供三个月免费试用，之后订阅费用为每月32.8元，或每年349元。

硬件上采用超清双摄设置：12MP长焦镜头和8MP广角镜头，均配备f/1.6大光圈和6P镜头，支持4K画质监控和超低光全彩夜视。 长焦端焦距8mm，分辨率4096x3072，支持自动对焦捕捉细节；广角端焦距2.8mm，127°超广角覆盖整个场景。 通过两颗镜头的协同，实现了3倍无损变焦和12倍混合变焦，甚至还增加了摄影模式，让相机捕捉安全之外的日常家庭瞬间。 云台电机速度较C700提升30%，支持水平360°、垂直180°全全景，结合指定人员和宠物检测跟踪，实现无缝无盲点动态跟踪。
